lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: This was the review-round-1 fix story for CAM-213 (prd.review.lastVerdict was FIXES_PENDING:1, 1 WARNING finding). Fixed: runSpecPersist (src/commands/spec.ts) now guards that the JSON.parse'd stdin payload is a non-null, non-array object immediately after the parse try/catch, before branching into either the real specifyIssueOnMain call or the persistFn test bypass. A malformed-shape payload (verified against the exact repro: `echo 'null' | cam spec --persist CAM-999`, plus 5, "hi", [] as belt-and-suspenders) now cleanly emits `CAM_SPEC_RESULT=ERROR reason=invalid-spec` and exits 1, instead of an uncaught TypeError with no handback line. Two new tests added to test/commands/spec.test.ts describe('runSpecPersist'): one exercising the real specifyIssueOnMain path (proves zero git spawn calls happen), one exercising the persistFn-bypass path (proves persistFn is never called). All userStories in prd.json now have passes:true (US-001, US-002, US-R1-001). Next agent invocation should find no non-operator passes:false stories and emit PRD_COMPLETE so the orchestrator re-runs /cam-review for round 2 (the review cycle is not yet terminal: prd.review.lastVerdict is still the stale FIXES_PENDING:1 from round 1 until the next review dispatch overwrites it).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure JS/TypeScript null-guard fix (JSON.parse result shape validation) plus test additions. No new external dependency or library API surface touched; specifyIssueOnMain/validateSpec are internal project code already covered by the CAM-213 US-001 officialDocsValidated entry.
